name: @matapao/vindu-frame
description: vindu's Electron app: Desktop's window on this computer, the same page a browser shows. It starts the app's own server process on this computer.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p .
scripts.test: node --test dist/test/link-routing.js && node dist/test/smoke.js && node dist/test/live.js && node dist/test/links.js
